brief: Describe the role: the team, what the person will do, and what they need to know.
name: Job posting and interview plan
description: Writes the posting and the interview plan at the same time, then checks the posting for words that put good people off.

steps.prompt:
From this description, write the job posting: what the person will do in the first six months, what they need to know, what is nice to have, and how the team works. No buzzwords.

{{brief}}

For the same role, write an interview plan: four rounds at most, what each round checks, and three questions per round with what a good answer shows.

{{brief}}
Is there anything in the posting that would put qualified people off for no reason: gendered words, years of experience where a skill is meant, needs that are really nice to have?
